images.author: Bruno Bimbato / ICMBio

images.why: Precisely captioned aerial of the Purus near Lábrea, photographed 27 February 2021, winding through rainforest. Strong location match, but this accessible 774px-wide version falls below the preferred resolution.

images.author: Camargo
